description: This CSS file contains styling rules for the home screen of a food exploration application, defining the layout and appearance of various UI elements such as titles, containers, buttons, and grids.

classes.name: screen
classes.description: Defines the overall layout and dimensions of the home screen.

classes.name: foodgo-title
classes.description: Styles the title section of the home screen.

classes.name: subtitle
classes.description: Styles the subtitle section of the home screen.

classes.name: profile-container
classes.description: Styles the profile section, including user profile images.

classes.name: filter-button
classes.description: Styles the button for applying filters on the food list.

classes.name: category-list
classes.description: Styles the list of categories for food filtering.

classes.name: food-grid
classes.description: Styles the grid layout for displaying food items.

classes.name: food-card
classes.description: Styles individual food item cards shown in the food grid.

classes.name: rating-container
classes.description: Styles the container that displays ratings for the food.

classes.name: bottom-nav
classes.description: Styles the bottom navigation bar of the application.

classes.name: add-button
classes.description: Styles the button for adding a new food item.
